analysis: OLS on the first K positions of an order, K = 1..768; validation R^2

splits.scored: the 5 validation folds; the 20% hold-out is not read

labels: as linear_cv.py: per cell, the mean of each descriptor over segmenter seeds 0-24 in which the cell passed QC

orders.top: |Pearson r| with the descriptor on the fold's training cells, strongest first
orders.random: 10 orders from np.random.default_rng(0), shared by all folds and descriptors

score: R^2 = 1 - SSE / SSE(training mean) on the validation fold
k_768: linear_cv's validation MSE (its Gram matrix is singular)

columns.dim: the position added at step k
columns.draw: random order index; -1 for top and bottom

weights.beta: w * sd(x_j) / sd(y), sds (ddof=1) on the fold's training cells

aggregation: one row per fold model; summarize as mean and sd (ddof=1) over the 5 folds
